usageNotes: Retrieves the PDM instance-level notes as a UTF-8 encoded Markdown string — useful for storing and reading shared operational notes visible to all Datacenter Manager admins. No parameters are required; the call simply returns whatever Markdown content has been saved at the system level. Requires the System.Audit privilege on the /system ACL path.

examples.summary: Fetch the current PDM instance notes

tips: The response is raw Markdown text — render it client-side if displaying to users.
If no notes have been set, the API may return an empty string or null; handle both cases.
API tokens are supported (allowtoken: true), so a read-only service account token with System.Audit is sufficient.
